recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future desire to harmonize the split-element wording should be handled as a follow-up to FHIR-51939 or a new OO decision, not as a late FHIR-36696 fix.
issue_request: FHIR-36696 was a Published OO change request with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked to replace BiologicallyDerivedProduct.collection.source content description text from "Who is product from" to "The patient or entity providing the product" and to replace the BiologicallyDerivedProduct.productCode detailed description with the approved codified-value wording for medical products of human origin.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation by commit d48dddc5a71994a6ea4f5fb5e6fe0cf84426d0bd in HL7/fhir#1858, later merged as 43912e2929. That commit changed the old productCode definition to the approved codified-value text and changed the old collection.source short display to "The patient or entity providing the product."
additional_context: BiologicallyDerivedProduct is active in source/fhir.ini. The old combined collection.source element no longer exists because FHIR-37953 later refined its wording and FHIR-51939 later split it into collection.sourcePatient and collection.sourceOrganization. Both later issues are already represented on the combined reconciliation branch, and their current split-element wording supersedes the older combined display text without losing the FHIR-36696 meaning.
reconciliation: An empty no-change audit commit was published. The authoritative source already contains the approved productCode definition, and the current sourcePatient/sourceOrganization elements carry forward the collection-source meaning through later, more specific work-group decisions.
